flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4101 then Open the booking form for a free first visit.
Enter the name Sam Rivera and the email sam@example.com, choose the visit date 2 November 2026 and the arrival time noon, accept the climbing waiver and confirm the booking.
Wait 5 seconds, then verify the text PL-4821 is still visible on the page.

verdict.root_cause: The form treats the requested visit date as invalid even after the agent entered it in both the requested written format and the standard YYYY-MM-DD format. This prevented the booking from being completed.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent followed the requested booking flow: it entered the requested date, selected noon and accepted the waiver before confirming. When the first confirmation exposed a date error, it also retried using the standard date format "2026-11-02". The form still did not complete the booking, so the missing PL-4821 result was caused by the form rejecting valid input rather than by an agent action.
verdict.bug_title: Valid visit date is rejected by booking form
verdict.suggestion: Fix date validation so 2 November 2026 is accepted and a successful confirmation displays PL-4821.
verdict.one_liner: The booking form rejected the requested 2 November 2026 visit date, so no confirmation code was produced for the final check.
